notes.title: Rosemary focaccia
notes.body:
# Rosemary focaccia

A reliable weekend loaf. High hydration, long cold proof.

## Dough
- 500 g bread flour
- 400 g water (80% hydration)
- 10 g salt
- 7 g instant yeast
- 40 g olive oil

Mix, fold four times over the first two hours, then cold-proof overnight.

## Bake
Dimple the dough, top with rosemary and flaky salt, and bake at 220°C (425°F)
for 22 minutes until deep gold. Cool on a rack before slicing.

notes.title: Deploy runbook
notes.body:
# Deploy runbook

Steps to push the API to production. Run from the repo root.

```bash
npm run build
npm run migrate:prod
export DATABASE_URL="$PROD_DATABASE_URL"
pg_dump --schema-only owl_prod > backup/schema.sql
npm run deploy -- --env production
```

Health check: hit `/healthz` and confirm it returns `{"status":"ok"}`. If the
migration step fails, roll back with `npm run migrate:undo` before retrying.

notes.title: Git cheatsheet
notes.body:
# Git cheatsheet

Commands I always forget.

```bash
git switch -c feature/name        # new branch
git restore --staged file.js      # unstage
git commit --amend --no-edit      # fix the last commit
git rebase -i HEAD~3              # squash the last three
git reflog                        # find a lost commit
git clean -fd                     # remove untracked files
```

To undo a bad merge that is not yet pushed: `git reset --hard ORIG_HEAD`.

notes.title: Home server setup
notes.body:
# Home server setup

Notes for the little box in the closet.

- Static IP: 192.168.1.50
- SSH on port 2222 (not the default)
- Reverse proxy: Caddy, config at /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
- Media service on port 8096
- Nightly backup cron at 03:00 to the external drive

If a service will not start, check `journalctl -u caddy` first, then disk space
with `df -h`.

notes.title: Overnight oats, base recipe
notes.body:
# Overnight oats, base recipe

The no-cook breakfast. Assemble the night before.

- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup yogurt
- 1 tbsp chia seeds
- a drizzle of honey

Stir, cover, and let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours (overnight
is best) so the oats and chia soften. Top with fruit in the morning.

notes.title: 緑茶の淹れ方
notes.body:
# 緑茶の淹れ方

おいしい緑茶をいれるための覚え書き。

- 湯の温度: 80度まで冷ます
- 茶葉: 一人あたり3グラム
- 抽出時間: 2分

熱すぎるお湯は苦みが出るので、必ず一度沸かしてから少し冷ますこと。二煎目は
30秒で十分。
